description: Create a preliminary project plan, price range and development effort estimate. Use this tool to understand the main functional modules and important unresolved requirements. Provide an existing project_context_id or a project_description for a new project. Module status describes The2410's proposed solution; confirmed does not mean customer approval. Prices and working days are shares of the existing project estimate. This is a preliminary estimate, not a final specification or contractual offer. Building the plan runs a detailed analysis on The2410's side, so the customer's name and email are required. They are saved with the project, and The2410 may contact the customer about it. Phone and company name are optional. The plan can be updated by calling this tool again.

additional_requirements.description: Updated requirements or answers to planning questions. Omit to keep the current ones.

company_name.description: Optional company name. Omit to keep the saved value.

phone.description: Optional phone number. Omit to keep the saved value.

project_context_id.description: Existing project UUID. Required when project_description is omitted.

project_description.description: Required for a new project. Omit or send null to reuse the saved description.

name: plan-project-tool
title: Plan project
